                };


        
                window.triggerTabs = function (init) {
 
                // Init jQuery UI Tabs
                const $tabsContainer = $('.s-events__tabs');
                $tabsContainer.tabs({
                    create: function (event, ui) {
                        ui.tab.attr({ tabindex: '0', });
                    },
                    activate: function (event, ui) {
                        ui.oldTab.find('a').attr({ tabindex: '-1', });
                        ui.newTab.find('a').attr({ tabindex: '0', });
 
                        ui.oldPanel.attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
                        ui.newPanel.attr('aria-hidden', 'false');
                    }
                });
 
                const $tabList = $('.s-events__tabs-nav');
                const $tabLinks = $('.s-events__tabs-link');
 
                // Set up ARIA attributes for links
                $tabLinks.each(function (i) {
                    const $link = $(this);
                    const panelId = $link.attr('href').substring(1);
                    $link.removeAttr('role');
                    $link.attr({
                        id: 'tab-' + i,
                        'aria-controls': panelId,
                        tabindex: i === 0 ? '0' : '-1'
                    });
                });
 
                // Keyboard Navigation
                $tabLinks.on('keydown', function (e) {
                    const $tabs = $tabLinks;
                    const currentIndex = $tabs.index(this);
                    let newIndex = null;
 
                    if (['ArrowRight', 'ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)) {
                        newIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % $tabs.length;
                    } else if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowUp'].includes(e.key)) {
                        newIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + $tabs.length) % $tabs.length;
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        newIndex = 0;
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        newIndex = $tabs.length - 1;
                    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        $(this).trigger('click');
                        return;
                    }
 
                    if (newIndex !== null) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        $tabs.eq(newIndex).focus();
                    }
                });
            };
 
            window.triggerTabs(0);
 
            //Prevents double tab stops with tabs
            $(function() {

                });
                var targetNode = document.querySelector('section.s-events');
                var config = { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] };

            });
